_about: Routing battery: which SEARCH STRATEGY the planner (api/lib/search-plan.js) should choose. Each case lists the shapes that are acceptable (a genuinely ambiguous query lists several), and optionally the tradition / author / comparative it must pick. tradition 'none' = must not narrow; omitted = not judged. Type-battery cases are mapped by TYPE_SHAPES; the edge cases below are written by hand. 2026-10-07.
